# Baseline A Narrative Synthesis: GRAIL, Inc.

Case: dev-biotech-grail-2020
Cutoff: 2020-09-17
Input fingerprint: 31fe1a09cdc9

## Narrative
- GRAIL, Inc. is summarized from 2 cutoff-visible public evidence records dated on or before 2020-09-17.
- The normalized claim list contains 10 cited observations from source classes: company-primary, regulatory-filing.
- As of the 2020-09-09 release, GRAIL said the number of shares and price range had not yet been determined.
- GRAIL announced on 2020-09-09 that it filed a Form S-1 for a proposed IPO.
- GRAIL planned to commercially launch Galleri in 2021 as a laboratory developed test.
- GRAIL reported a USD 136.4 million net loss for the six months ended 2020-06-30.
- GRAIL said it applied to list common stock on Nasdaq under ticker GRAL.

## Evidence Notes
- GRAIL announces filing of registration statement for proposed IPO [ev-3e462cd1db7e]
  - As of the 2020-09-09 release, GRAIL said the number of shares and price range had not yet been determined. (value=not determined; period=instant 2020-09-09)
  - GRAIL announced on 2020-09-09 that it filed a Form S-1 for a proposed IPO. (value=Form S-1 filed; period=instant 2020-09-09)
  - GRAIL said it applied to list common stock on Nasdaq under ticker GRAL. (value=GRAL; unit=ticker; period=instant 2020-09-09)
- GRAIL, Inc. Form S-1/A [ev-d6c3dac52c28]
  - GRAIL planned to commercially launch Galleri in 2021 as a laboratory developed test. (value=Galleri planned 2021 LDT launch; period=instant 2020-09-17)
  - GRAIL reported a USD 136.4 million net loss for the six months ended 2020-06-30. (value=136.4; unit=USD millions net loss; period=start 2020-01-01, end 2020-06-30)
  - GRAIL stated it did not yet have a commercial product for sale. (value=true; period=instant 2020-09-17)
  - GRAIL stated it had not generated revenues to date and did not expect revenues until products were commercialized. (value=true; period=instant 2020-09-17)
  - GRAIL stated its foundational clinical trials had more than 115,000 subjects already enrolled. (value=115000; unit=subjects, greater than; period=instant 2020-08-31)
  - The S-1/A identifies the registrant as GRAIL, Inc., incorporated in Delaware, with CIK 0001699031. (value=SEC-CIK-0001699031; unit=SEC CIK; period=instant 2020-09-17)
  - Through 2020-06-30, GRAIL stated it had raised over USD 1.9 billion from venture and strategic partners. (value=1.9; unit=USD billions raised, greater than; period=instant 2020-06-30)

## Limitations
- This baseline performs deterministic evidence summarization only.
- It does not run TRACE route selection, sufficiency gating, valuation logic, or adversarial review.
- It does not claim official contest compliance, benchmark superiority, investment advice, or appraisal status.
- Source use follows the committed policy: Raw source documents, PDFs, cached pages, and scratch downloads stay out of Git unless redistribution rights are explicitly established.
